updateTime.description: Date and time when this Sentinel-3 completeness document was last updated

key.description: Unique document key built from the datatake identifier, product type and timeliness

mission.description: Mission identifier derived from the satellite unit (S3)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit this completeness applies to (e.g. S3A, S3B)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake this completeness is computed for

observation_time_start.description: Start of the observation period covered by this completeness

observation_time_stop.description: Stop of the observation period covered by this completeness

observation_duration.description: Duration of the observation period in microseconds

timeliness.description: Timeliness of the products this completeness applies to

product_type.description: Product type this completeness applies to

product_level.description: Product level of the product type (e.g. L0_, L1, L2)

expected.description: Expected sensing value for the product type, in microseconds, including tolerance

value.description: Measured completeness value, total sensing of the produced products in microseconds

value_adjusted.description: Completeness value capped at the expected value to avoid percentages above 100%

percentage.description: Completeness percentage of adjusted value over expected value

status.description: Completeness status label derived from the percentage

cams_tickets.description: List of CAMS ticket identifiers linked to this completeness

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin of the last attached CAMS ticket

cams_description.description: Description of the last attached CAMS ticket
